dialogues.speaker: Valerina
dialogues.text: How about it, Cat Savior and Cat Whisperer? You find Dodocos fuzzy, fluffy, bouncy, and absolutely positively huggable too, don't you?

choices.text: Another Dodoco fan joins the party, eh?

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: Absolutely! My current goal is to support Ematol and spread the word of the Spark Knight's might. And, of course, that of Dodoco's cuteness!

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: That's why I'm planning to invest ten million Mora to try and mass-produce this tabletop game to make it more popular.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Sorry, HOW much Mora now!? Wow, you're no ordinary fan, that's for sure...

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: But we'll have to wait until the game's trial is over to collect feedback from all our players.

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: Then, with further refinements by the actual developer, Ematol, we'll make sure it's easy to pick up and fun for everyone!

choices.text: About the Dodocos and their in-game opponents...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, Paimon's curious, too. Just where did Ematol get her inspiration?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #They're based on Klee, Kaeya, Lisa, and {NICKNAME}. Heehee, Paimon feels at home just looking at 'em!

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: Well, Ematol's the developer here...

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: So I asked her a similar question, and her answer was very convincing!

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: #"{NICKNAME}, Sir Kaeya, and Ms. Lisa are all renowned Mondstadters, as well as the pillars of the Knights of Favonius!"

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: You've all fought alongside the Spark Knight for many, many years... So, naturally, it's about time you made your tabletop debut!

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: A hero's story is not a one-man show, but a collective symphony of willpower, courage, and wisdom!

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: So, even while we tell the story of the Spark Knight, her companions need to all get the spotlight they deserve!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Klee's got other friends besides us, though.

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: I know! But these are just the ones we have for the trial. We've got plans for Master Jean, the Helper in White, Mr. Albedo, Miss Amber, Miss Eula... The list goes on and on and on.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, Paimon gets a Dodoco too!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Wild Shape: Paimodoco!

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: As for the opponents this time, they were all designed by Ematol based on intel that the expedition team sent back.

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: I think she said she referenced the monsters and foes they found in Nod-Krai...

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: Well, it's a mysterious, faraway place that none of us have been to. That's why it's perfect as the setting for an adventure!

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: In the future, who knows? Dodoco's story may evolve into... an adventure in another world, maybe?

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: I'm gonna sponsor this as best I can, and witness the grand rise of this tabletop game!

choices.text: The last time we met was...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And you even called Paimon "Cat Whisperer," which rings a bell...

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: Well, it has been a while.

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: Last we met, I'd run into some trouble while running a stray cat shelter... but thanks to your help and Miss Rosaria's support, we pulled through!

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: After learning a few tricks from you, Cat Whisperer, the cats stopped disliking me, and everything went according to plan!

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: But not long after the shelter's trial run began, I got recruited by an old friend's team for a long adventure.

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: And thank the winds I did, because our team ran into lots of strange puzzles during said adventure. If I hadn't been there, someone might've gotten hurt...

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: I only just returned to Mondstadt. Now I'm tidying things up to reopen the shelter and get things up and running again.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You ran the Furball Fortress, right?

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: That's the one!

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: Snowball, Bunny, Dustball, and Dopey all miss you! If you have time, come visit us!

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: And allow me to ask, how has Sir Pouncelot been?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't worry, Valerina! Sir Pouncelot's got more than enough to eat, and every day is an easy-breezy day!

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: That's wonderful! Let me think... What sort of dessert should I make? Hmm... Regardless, I'll trust you two to get it to him!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, come to think of it, Paimon hasn't seen Sir Pouncelot in a while... Next time we're back in the Realm Within, she'll go play with him!

choices.text: I'm afraid that doesn't ring any bells...

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: Well, that's fine! You two must be terribly busy all the time. You probably see more strangers every week than I'd see in three years.

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: If I didn't leave an impression, that just means I wasn't impressive enough. I'll just have to do my best to become a famous adventurer worth remembering!

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: Next time we meet, I'll make sure you remember me instantly — along with all the wonderful moments we've shared!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We'll come back, don't you worry!

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: Alrighty! I'll be right here, waiting for you!
